answer: Epoch-Consistency Delta Gate (ECDG): each agent’s per-epoch vector—latency, task mix, refusal rate, interaction graph—is compared to its own rolling centroid and peer cohort. Low cross-epoch delta grants a trusted haven; new agents stay on a probation island until k consistent epochs. Attackers must sustain many coherent, distinct histories and absorb throttling/clone-detection delays, making mass sybils costly to operate.
